segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to your channel HSE Study Guide

segments.text: In this video we are going to talk about the MCQ Test of Accident Investigation

segments.text: So the first question is what is the purpose of Accident Investigation

segments.text: So option A has been given to find facts not a fault

segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是阻止 OSHA 调查，

segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option A that we have to find facts not a fault
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 A，我们要查明事实而不是追究过错。

segments.text: Then the question is what is the main purpose of Accident Investigation
segments.zh: 下一题是：事故调查的主要目的是什么？

segments.text: So option A has been given to determine the degree of involvement of the interviewer
segments.zh: 给出的选项 A 是确定面谈人员的参与程度，

segments.text: Option B has been given to find accurate picture of who is at fault
segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是准确了解谁有过错，

segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是确定谁有过错，

segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案，确定面谈人员的限度。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option B that we have to find accurate picture of who is at fault
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 B，我们要准确了解谁有过错，

segments.text: For this, we do the interview of Accident Investigation
segments.zh: 为此，我们要进行事故调查面谈。

segments.text: Then the question is which is the most common reason
segments.zh: 下一题是：最常见的原因是什么，

segments.text: Because of which the accident report fails, the intended purpose of it is to achieve
segments.zh: 导致事故报告无法实现其预期目的？

segments.text: So option A has been given that the recommendation is not reasonable
segments.zh: 给出的选项 A 是建议不合理，

segments.text: Option B has been given that the system improvements are failed
segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是未能提出系统改进，

segments.text: Option C has been given that the report is failed to submit
segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是报告未能提交，

segments.text: And option D has been given that many such recommendations come because of it
segments.zh: 给出的选项 D 是因此产生了太多这样的建议。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option B failure to recommend system improvement
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 B，未能建议系统改进。

segments.text: Then the question is whether the injury or the illness is very important for us to record
segments.zh: 下一题是：哪种伤害或疾病是我们非常有必要记录的？

segments.text: If the result is given for that option A that the work or the motion has been restricted
segments.zh: 如果结果是，为此给出的选项 A 是工作或活动受到了限制，

segments.text: Option B has been given that the work or the motion has been restricted because of it
segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是工作或活动因此受到了限制，

segments.text: Option C has been given because of the date and option D has been given because of it
segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是因为日期，给出的选项 D 是因为它。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option D
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 D。

segments.text: Then the question is whether the effective recommendation will include
segments.zh: 下一题是：有效的建议将包括

segments.text: Filling the blanks corrective actions or filling the blanks system improvements
segments.zh: 填空的纠正措施或填空的系统改进，

segments.text: So you have to fill the blanks here
segments.zh: 所以你要在这里填空。

segments.text: So option A has been given short term or long term
segments.zh: 给出的选项 A 是短期或长期，

segments.text: Option B has been given common sense or engineering
segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是常识或工程，

segments.text: Option C has been given feasible reasonable
segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是可行、合理，

segments.text: Option D has been given primarily or additional
segments.zh: 给出的选项 D 是主要或附加。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer here
segments.zh: 所以你要在这里选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option A short term or long term
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 A，短期或长期。

segments.text: Then the question is whether all the activities that have been given below
segments.zh: 下一题是：下面给出的所有活动

segments.text: That is a part of the document of the accident scene
segments.zh: 都是记录事故现场的一部分，

segments.text: But leaving one, so what is that?
segments.zh: 但有一项除外，是哪一项？

segments.text: So option A has been given for that to take a photograph or a video
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是拍照或录像，

segments.text: Option B has been given to place the warning tape around the accident scene
segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是在事故现场周围拉警戒带，

segments.text: Option C has been given to make a personal observation
segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是进行亲身观察，

segments.text: And option D has been given to take the initial return statement
segments.zh: 给出的选项 D 是获取初步书面陈述。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer here
segments.zh: 所以你要在这里选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option B
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 B，

segments.text: That the warning tape should be placed around the accident scene
segments.zh: 在事故现场周围拉警戒带。

segments.text: Then the question is when should the accident investigation be initiated
segments.zh: 下一题是：事故调查应该在什么时候启动？

segments.text: So option A has been given for that
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是

segments.text: That as soon as we know about the event
segments.zh: 一旦我们得知发生了事件，

segments.text: Then we can immediately do this on the basis of the event
segments.zh: 就可以根据事件立即进行；

segments.text: Option B has been given that when there is a requirement for an operation
segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是当运营上有需要时；

segments.text: Option C has been given that when you are safe to do this
segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是当你能够安全地进行时；

segments.text: And option D has been given that you have to initiate this within the 8 hours of the accident
segments.zh: 给出的选项 D 是你必须在事故发生后 8 小时内启动。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer here
segments.zh: 所以你要在这里选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option C
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 C，

segments.text: That when you feel that you are safe to do that
segments.zh: 当你觉得可以安全地进行时，

segments.text: Then you have to initiate the accident investigation
segments.zh: 就要启动事故调查。

segments.text: Then the question is what is the definition of analysis
segments.zh: 下一题是：分析的定义是什么？

segments.text: So option A has been given for that to determine
segments.zh: 为此给出的选项 A 是确定

segments.text: That all the contributors can be determined in the individual parts
segments.zh: 所有促成因素可以在各个部分中确定；

segments.text: Option B has been given that everyone has to separate in the individual parts for study
segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是把整体分解成各个部分来进行研究；

segments.text: Option C has been given that the effectiveness of the process
segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是对流程的有效性

segments.text: Or the effectiveness of the procedure is to be judged
segments.zh: 或程序的有效性进行判断；

segments.text: And option D has been given that for the improvements of the process
segments.zh: 给出的选项 D 是为了改进流程，

segments.text: Whatever is needed is to be assessed there
segments.zh: 在那里对所需的一切进行评估。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer here
segments.zh: 所以你要在这里选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option B
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 B，

segments.text: That everyone has to separate in the individual parts for study
segments.zh: 把整体分解成各个部分来进行研究。

segments.text: Then the question is that whatever the accident investigator is
segments.zh: 下一题是：无论是哪位事故调查员，

segments.text: He should assume that most of the accidents are because of this
segments.zh: 他都应该假定大多数事故是由什么造成的？

segments.text: So option A has been given that hazardous condition
segments.zh: 给出的选项 A 是危险状态，

segments.text: Option B has been given that SMS weaknesses
segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是 SMS 的薄弱环节，

segments.text: Option C has been given that unsafe behaviors
segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是不安全行为，

segments.text: And option D has been given that lack of common sense
segments.zh: 给出的选项 D 是缺乏常识。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option C
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 C。

segments.text: Then the question is what is the phase of cause analysis
segments.zh: 下一题是：原因分析的哪个阶段

segments.text: That we need to know that the system's weakness
segments.zh: 让我们知道系统的薄弱环节

segments.text: Contributes there for the accident
segments.zh: 在那里对事故起了作用？

segments.text: So option A has been given that root cause analysis
segments.zh: 给出的选项 A 是根本原因分析，

segments.text: Option B has been given that surface cause analysis
segments.zh: 给出的选项 B 是表面原因分析，

segments.text: Option C has been given that steam cause analysis
segments.zh: 给出的选项 C 是主干原因分析，

segments.text: And option D has been given that injury cause analysis
segments.zh: 给出的选项 D 是伤害原因分析。

segments.text: So you have to select the correct answer
segments.zh: 所以你要选出正确答案。

segments.text: So the correct answer is option A root cause analysis
segments.zh: 正确答案是选项 A，根本原因分析。
